#summary How to use AmFast to encode and decode AMF.

= Encoding =

{{{
import amfast.encoder as encoder
byte_string = encoder.encode(value)
}}}

encode(...)
    Description:
    =============
    Encode a Python object in AMF format.
    
    Useage:
    ===========
    byte_string = encode(value, **kwargs)
    
    Optional keyword arguments:
    ============================
     * amf3 - bool - True to encode as AMF3 format. - Default = False
     * packet - bool - True to encode a AMF packet. - Default = False
     * use_array_collections - bool - True to encode lists and tuples as !ArrayCollections - Default = False
     * use_object_proxies - bool - True to encode dicts as !ObjectProxys - Default = False
     * use_references - bool - True to encode multiply occuring objects as references - Default = True
     * use_legacy_xml - bool - True to encode XML as old XMLDocument instead of E4X - Default = False
     * include_private - bool - True to encode attributes starting with an underscore - Default = False
     * class_def_mapper - !ClassDefMapper - object that retrieves a !ClassDef object used for customizing serialization of objects - Default = None (all objects are anonymous)

= Decoding =

{{{
import amfast.decoder as decoder
py_obj = decoder.decode(byte_string)
}}}

decode(...)
    Description:
    =============
    Decode an AMF3 stream to Python objects.
    
    Useage:
    ===========
    py_obj = decode(value, **kwargs)
    
    Optional keyword arguments:
    ============================
     * packet - bool - True to decode as an AMF !NetConnection packet (decode a remoting call). - Default = False
     * amf3 - bool - True to decode as AMF3 format. - Default = False
     * class_def_mapper - !ClassDefMapper - object that retrieves a !ClassDef object used for customizing de-serialization of objects - Default = None (all objects are anonymous)
